containers.intro: Thirteen models, one job: get food from your kitchen to someone’s table looking like it never left. Every Silverpot container is pressed from aluminium in our Ajman facility and comes with a matching lid. Pick a single-compartment model for everyday takeaway, split a meal with the 2- or 3-compartment 8576, or go straight to the 83166, shaped for broast. Not sure which size fits your portions? Use the size finder or send us your menu on WhatsApp. We’ll match it to a model code.

platters.intro: Four platters for food that’s meant to be shared: catering trays, buffet lines, majlis spreads and big family orders. Models 6550, 6586, 65180 and 65220 are pressed from aluminium in Ajman for kitchens that serve the whole room at once. Need a lid, a specific size or a mixed carton? Add the models to your quote and tell us.
platters.introNote: Platter shapes, sizes and lid options

foil.intro: Aluminium foil in two widths: 30 cm for everyday kitchens, and 45 cm for wide trays and professional prep. Choose household rolls from 13.5 to 200 sq ft, catering rolls in 150 m and 300 m lengths for busy kitchens, or promo packs built for retail shelves. Wrap shawarma, line trays, cover a biryani and keep the heat where it belongs.

about.heroSpeech: That’s our press line. Coil goes in, a container comes out. One stroke each, all day.
about.story1: Al Mohamadi Light Industries Co. LLC started in 1997 in the Emirate of Ajman, making and distributing disposable packaging for the food business. Nearly three decades later, the name on the carton is Silverpot, and the job hasn’t changed: make aluminium containers, platters and foil that kitchens can trust on their busiest day.
about.story2: We’ve invested in modern machinery and in a team that knows the difference between “almost right” and right. We aim for products that are high quality, easy to use and responsible by design, because packaging that’s used once still has to work perfectly.
about.processNote: Process wording to be checked with the factory

1.title: Coil
1.line: It starts as a coil of aluminium foil stock.

2.title: Feed
2.line: The coil unrolls into the press line, flat and fast.

3.title: Press
3.line: A die presses each sheet into shape in a single stroke.

4.title: Trim and rim
4.line: Edges are trimmed and the rim is rolled so lids sit tight.

5.title: Check and count
5.line: Containers are checked, counted and stacked.

6.title: Pack and ship
6.line: Cartons are packed, labelled and sent out across the UAE.

sustainability.sub: Aluminium is one of the few packaging materials that can be recycled again and again without losing its quality. That makes “disposable” a bit of a misnomer.

how.1: Scrape off leftover food. A quick rinse is enough; it doesn’t need to sparkle.
how.2: Take off paper or board lids and recycle them with paper.
how.3: Scrunch used foil into a ball about the size of your fist. Small scraps are easier to sort that way.
how.4: Use the recycling bins provided by your emirate’s municipality or your building.
